consent.title: Bincike Na Amfani Ba Tare Da Suna Ba

consent.privacyNote: An kashe shi ta asali. Babu abin da ake turawa har sai ka kunna wannan, kuma kana iya canza shi kowane lokaci.
consent.toggleLabel: Raba bincike ba tare da suna ba
consent.privacyScreenFooter: PrayCalc tana ba da fifiko ga sirri. Bincike ba shi da suna kuma an kashe shi sai dai ka zaɓi shiga. Kashe wannan yana dakatar da duk telemetry nan take.
